title: The Brass Astrolabe of Backward Noon
description: At Backward Noon, the instrument maker turns the brass astrolabe. Its shadow climbs the steps while the sun hangs inside the rings.
alt: A woman in blue turns a giant suspended brass astrolabe, casting a wheel of dark shadows across terracotta steps.
pairing: An imagined summer solar holiday × a brass astrolabe whose shadow climbs uphill
